additional_info.subject: ID0398542-DC/Si-D/BR-[Y2 / R3 313020197005] Connector unavailable CRM:00642001922
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Hope you are doing great.
We received this case from an end customer regarding an unavailable connector. We have noticed that the charger is offline on SCB and are attempting to get it back online.
Additionally, we have observed that the emergency stop button has been pressed on the charger. Please release it.
Also, We need to investigate the resistance of the Temperature sensor.  It Should as per the PT1000
To investigate BT1 and BT2, we need to measure the voltage between I2 and Ground, ensuring it is comparable to the voltage between I8 and Ground.
Similarly, we should measure the voltage between I1 and Ground, ensuring it is comparable to the voltage between I7 and Ground.
Additionally, the LOGO is currently running on firmware version 2.6.0, and it needs to be updated to version 2.7.0.The Charger is on firmware version 2.5.9.4.
Once the Charger is in a healthy state, we recommend updating it to the latest firmware version 6.0.3.
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0398542 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-
